articles.headline: Pirelli and Balkrishna strike India tyre production deal
articles.brief: Pirelli has partnered with Balkrishna Industries to launch a new tyre production venture in India, expanding their manufacturing footprint in the region to cater to growing local and international demand.

articles.headline: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs in AI-powered cost drive
articles.brief: British banking giant Barclays has announced plans to eliminate 5,000 positions this year as part of an aggressive, technology-driven restructuring aimed at streamlining operations and integrating automated processes.

articles.headline: Nokia third-quarter profit beats forecasts on AI sales
articles.brief: Nokia reported a stronger-than-expected third-quarter profit, bolstered by surging demand for artificial intelligence-driven network infrastructure and telecommunications equipment across global markets.

articles.headline: UK restarts large-calibre weapon manufacturing after decades
articles.brief: In a major defense push, the United Kingdom has officially resumed domestic manufacturing of large-calibre military weapons for the first time in twenty years to bolster security capabilities.

articles.headline: India weighs hardware security monitor for Starlink, others
articles.brief: New Delhi is evaluating a proposal to mandate hardware checkpoints for foreign satellite internet providers, including Starlink, to monitor traffic and address domestic security vulnerabilities.

articles.headline: EU carbon tax policy described as inviting disaster
articles.brief: Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal criticized the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, warning that the incoming levy will inflate local living costs and severely hurt industrial competitiveness.

articles.headline: Magnitude 7.0 earthquake strikes Tibet near Nagqu
articles.brief: A powerful 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck northern Tibet near Nagqu at a shallow depth of ten kilometres, prompting emergency evaluations across the high-altitude region.

articles.headline: Iran claims oil tankers damaged in Strait of Hormuz
articles.brief: Iranian authorities reported that seven oil tankers sustained severe damage from maritime incidents in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating regional shipping security concerns.

articles.headline: Farm outfits write to President demanding CEC resignation
articles.brief: Samyukt Kisan Morcha and various trade unions have formally written to the President demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner, announcing nationwide protest rallies.

articles.headline: Hyderabad to host sickle cell and thalassemia congress
articles.brief: Medical experts and researchers from around the globe are gathering in Hyderabad for a three-day specialized congress focusing on advancements in treating sickle cell disease and thalassemia.

articles.headline: Rowghat gets first train service since independence
articles.brief: Indian Railways completed a major infrastructural milestone by opening a new railway line in Chhattisgarh, bringing the first-ever train to the remote area of Rowghat since independence.

articles.headline: India rate panel flags more hikes amid inflation risks
articles.brief: Minutes from India's rate-setting panel indicate members remain open to further interest rate hikes if inflationary pressures persist, though they caution against an excessively aggressive cycle.

articles.headline: Swiggy Narrows Losses While Revenue Climbs
articles.brief: Food delivery and quick-commerce major Swiggy reported a narrowed quarterly net loss alongside a solid year-on-year surge in overall operating revenues, according to its latest financial filings.

articles.headline: BrahMos missile developer outlines 1,500-km range roadmap
articles.brief: The BrahMos chief announced plans for an advanced missile prototype by 2027-2028, setting a strategic roadmap to achieve an extended operational range of up to 1,500 kilometres.
